name: input
accessibility: Always label it: wrap in Field or pass aria-label; a placeholder is a hint, not a label. `invalid` (or Field's `error`) sets aria-invalid and the error is read with the field.
example:
<Field label="Email" hint="We never share it.">
  <Input type="email" leadingIcon={<Mail />} placeholder="you@example.com" />
</Field>
